quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q nine months ended June 30, 2026: revenues were $332,789 thousand versus $277,563 thousand (+20%); DNA synthesis and protein solutions $160,905 thousand versus $122,491 thousand and NGS applications $171,884 thousand versus $155,072 thousand. By customer group, diagnostics provided $119,118 thousand versus $108,647 thousand, therapeutics $118,404 thousand versus $80,070 thousand, academic research and government $40,545 thousand versus $36,589 thousand, global supply partners $37,055 thousand versus $33,581 thousand and industry and applied $17,667 thousand versus $18,676 thousand. Net loss for the nine months was $109,579 thousand versus $50,532 thousand.
